summary: MaintCourseDetailsASM manages the maintenance and detail display/editing of course-related options for ASM (likely Assignment or Academic Service Management) within the HSPnet web platform. It controls the course options presented to users such as selection/visibility of campus/section, student permissions for selecting and viewing information, and service code assignments.
purpose: To provide a user interface and backend logic for administrators to configure and manage detailed course options, permissions, and associations related to campus, section, and services for ASM within the system.

workflows.name: Load and Display Course Details
steps: On page load, initialize user session and course context.
On data select, provide session and course ID as input to data source.
If no user session, cancel data retrieval.
On data bound, update display fields (e.g., converting zero MaxStudentPRSelections to 'Not Applicable').
Display/hide campus or section controls depending on whether those entities exist for the course.

workflows.name: Edit Course Details
steps: When edit invoked, switch FormView to Edit mode, bind data, and show modal if applicable.
Bind control values from the course entity into dropdowns and checkboxes.
Support for popup/modal controls for editing.

workflows.name: Update Course Details
steps: On item updating, read input values from controls (dropdowns, checkboxes, listboxes).
Populate new value map for all course control fields.
If 'allowAnySiteDestForSelectedService' is checked, assemble allowedServiceCodeList from selected ListBox items.
Call backend update with all collected values.
On successful update, cache the session and redirect user to details view.

workflows.name: Configure Visible Services
steps: Display or hide services selection row depending on checkbox state.
Allow moving services between included and not-included lists using Add/Remove (single or all) logic.
Persist service code selection as allowedServiceCodeList.

business_rules: If there is no user session on selection, the operation is cancelled.
When MaxStudentPRSelections is zero, show 'Not Applicable'.
If CampusesExist is false, hide campus controls.
If allowAnySiteDestForSelectedService is checked, the allowedServiceCodeList field must be populated.
student-visibility flags (e.g., studentsViewAgency, studentsViewDestinations) are controlled via checkboxes.
validations: User session must be present for all operations.
CourseID must be specified and valid.
All values from controls (checkboxes, dropdowns, listboxes) must be captured before update.
Only valid GUIDs are used for IDs linking documents and related files.
calculations: allowedServiceCodeList is constructed by joining the values of all selected ListBox items with a comma.
TextList and ValueList utility functions build comma-delimited lists from listbox items.
conditions: Visibility of campus and section controls depends on CampusesExist and business rules.
Display of services row depends on allowAnySiteDestForSelectedService checkbox.
system_behavior: Redirects to course details on update.
Displays or hides UI controls and sections depending on data and user actions.
Binds parameters to data sources for updates and selects.
dependencies: Dropdown, ListBox, CheckBox controls from ASP.NET WebForms
exceptions: On missing/invalid UserSession, course details will not load.
If required controls are not found (e.g., dropdowns, checkboxes), values may not be set or updated.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling is described for control-not-found scenarios.
Exact UI layout and all validation feedback messages are not fully detailed.
Assumes existence and correct configuration of backend objects (e.g., ServiceCodes, Course, HSPnetSession), but no source or schema for them.
Details on security or access control for editing/updates are not found.
